experiment_data.hypothesis: Per-layer KL s123 convergence curve: PPL at step 2000/4000/6000/8000 to determine how many training steps are needed. Useful for appendix (training efficiency analysis).

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/distill_sparse_swiglu && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 && export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 && export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 && export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 && export WANDB_MODE=disabled && for step in 2000 4000 6000 8000; do echo \"=== Step \${step} ===\" && python -u src/benchmark_eval.py --exp_id perlayer_kl_s123_convergence_step\${step} --model_name_or_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/llama-3.1-8b --checkpoint checkpoints/perlayer_kl_30_s123/predictor_perlayer_kl_step_\${step}.pt --sparsity_mode teal_global --sparsity_target 0.3 --allocation uniform --tasks wikitext2 --seq_len 2048 --gpu 0; done 2>&1"
